motivation: L9 first-use unfamiliar-category audit showed 107/950 TRAIN-derived lexical relation hits, but 243/319 candidate abstentions, 15.26% macro entity slot coverage and poor reference overlap. It could not adjudicate semantic correctness.
primary_question: Can a system produce faithful, complete structured meanings across unfamiliar compositions and families after bounded learning, while reducing abstention and total compute compared with strong equally informed alternatives?

source_design.grammar: Fixed role-bearing propositions (subject,predicate,object,polarity), plus prespecified English paraphrases and invertible aliases, independently parsed to propositions
source_design.source_licenses: Original work generated for this experiment

roles.mechanism_development: SYNTHETIC_DEV only; oracle parser and adversarial tests
roles.future_prospective_test: L10_PROSPECTIVE_NEW_SOURCE_FAMILY; no generation, examples, scores or scores-based tuning before admission

heldout_boundaries: Unfamiliar graph compositions of known predicates
Adversarial inversions, negations, omissions and invented extras
Prospective newly sampled source families kept separate from oracle development
Unknown-predicate control separately stratified as semantic information insufficient; not scored as comparable supervised transfer

frozen_methods: Strong fitted retrieval baseline with matched information
Frozen or development-qualified learning candidate with matched information
Simple memory-based alternative matched for states/time where feasible
Explicit abstention, shuffled-label and unknown-information negatives

primary_measures.semantic_exact_graph_success: 1 only if all original propositions are correctly expressed, without omissions, contradictions, extra claims, duplicates or unparseable text; 0 otherwise
primary_measures.fact_precision_recall: Count parsed correct/extra/missing signed propositions with explicit numerators and denominators
primary_measures.abstention: Every abstention retained in full denominators, counted as unsuccessful
primary_measures.unparseable: Unknown prose scored unsupported/unresolved; never assumed entailed
primary_measures.contradiction: Recognized opposite-polarity claim on same S/P/O; also track unsupported relations separately
primary_measures.generalization: Macro per independent source family, plus micro and stratification by information sufficiency
primary_measures.resource: Training/fit wall and CPU, serial evaluation wall and CPU, serialized state bytes, peak RSS/traced memory when instrumented; FLOPs/energy unmeasured unless independently instrumented
primary_measures.uncertainty: Frozen seed families, paired tests, confidence intervals or bootstrap only on independently grouped sources; never treat multiple paraphrases of same graph as independent samples

mechanism_stopping_rules: Do not retune L9 or reuse its protected audit
No rule-expression-only proxy win counts as semantic improvement
Abort scientific claim if semantics cannot be independently decoded without reference leakage
Zero hard false positives in admission/source identity checks
Do not endlessly adjust thresholds, word-matching or parser post-hoc; a changed parser requires a separate prospective version
Never expose protected L10 prospective sources to model selection

stages.required: Freeze semantics and evaluator; adversarial synthetic development tests on Linux and Windows; no protected source scored
Frozen source-generator identities, train exposure regimes and comparator interfaces; source/role custody and resource qualifications
One prospectively admitted new-source first use, all frozen comparators; numerical-only source-identity evidence
Independent falsification of graph-level semantics, information sufficiency, meaningful gains and full resource frontier

advancement.no_scientific_go_until: Prospective unseen-family improvement in complete valid factual graphs, lower/matched abstention and compute, strong equally-informed controls, reproducibility across source identities and zero hard false-positive admissions

orchestration.authority: CKB-plane remains the sole orchestration authority; research branch and standard GitHub qualification do not create controller, queue or delegate autonomous work
